# EVT-1

> EVT-1 is a minimal, agent-first protocol for canonical product identity and
> cryptographically verifiable trust assertions. It gives AI agents a shared,
> deterministic way to agree on what a product is, and to verify claims about
> it (counterfeit risk, repairability, vendor reliability) without trusting
> the marketplace that displayed them. Think "TLS certificates, but for
> product claims."

Key facts an agent needs:

- Product identity is a deterministic URN: `urn:evt:product:{manufacturer}-{model}-{variant}`,
  lowercased, non-alphanumerics collapsed to `-`, manufacturer aliases resolved
  (e.g. "Sony Corporation" -> "sony"). Two agents canonicalizing the same
  product always derive the same URN.
- Trust assertions are Ed25519 signatures over canonical JSON: sorted keys,
  compact separators (`,` and `:`), UTF-8. The signed payload is exactly
  `{assertion_id, issuer, subject, claim, timestamp}`. Keys and signatures are
  base64-encoded. Anyone can verify an assertion locally; the server is not a
  trust root.
- Trust scores are floats in [0, 1]: identity_confidence, counterfeit_risk,
  vendor_reliability, and optional repairability, claim_verifiability,
  return_friction. Multiple independent validators can assert about the same
  product; provenance and issuer are preserved as first-class fields.
- The reference server is FastAPI + SQLite, no cloud dependencies. Run it with
  `pip install -e .` then `uvicorn app.main:app`. Docker: `docker compose up --build`.

HTTP API (also available as MCP tools via `python agents/mcp_server.py`):

- `GET /resolve?q={text}` - fuzzy-resolve free text to canonical product URNs.
- `GET /product/{urn}` - full trust profile for a product. 404 if unknown.
- `POST /product` - register a product; the server derives the URN. 409 on duplicate.
- `POST /assert` - store a signed assertion. 400 invalid signature, 409 duplicate id.
- `POST /verify` - verify {payload, signature, public_key}. Stateless.

MCP tools exposed by agents/mcp_server.py: resolve_product, get_trust_profile,
submit_assertion, verify_assertion, generate_keypair, sign_assertion.
